fullContentHtml:
IERT Prayagraj Admissions Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Institute Of Engineering And Rural Technology IERT, Prayagraj has released the Admit Card for the Prayagraj Diploma Courses Admission 2026 on the official website of the IERT. Applications for the IERT Prayagraj Admissions Online Form 2026 were accepted from 05 February 2026 to 30 April 2026. The PET examination is going to be conducted on 30 June 2026 & 03 July 2026. Candidates who appeared in the exam can now check their IERT Prayagraj Admissions Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 February 2026
  • Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • Exam Date Engineering Diploma : 03 June 2026
  • Exam Date Other Courses : 03 July 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 20 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1350/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1350/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
